---
name: Skill feedback
about: A Whop skill gave wrong, outdated, missing or unclear guidance
title: "skill-feedback: <skill>: <what went wrong>"
---

<!-- Issues are public. Leave out API keys, webhook secrets, tokens, Whop IDs from your account (use biz_xxxxxxxxxxxxx), customer data and private code. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | `wrong`, `outdated`, `missing` or `unclear` |
| Skill | e.g. `whop-checkout`, version from `metadata.version` in its `SKILL.md` |
| Source | File and section, e.g. `SKILL.md` > Rules > 4 |
| Agent | The agent and model in use |
| Task | What you were trying to do |
| Expected | What should have happened, with the docs page that shows it, if any |
| Actual | What the skill said, or what happened when it was followed |
| Suggested fix | How the skill should change (optional) |
